title: OpenAI's AI Agents Work While You Sleep

beats.text: Did you know an AI assistant can now keep working after you close the chat? OpenAI just launched agents that get their very own computer.
beats.image_prompt: A glowing lone laptop floating in a dark digital void, screen alive with moving light while a sleeping city skyline lies below, cinematic, vertical composition

beats.text: OpenAI calls them dots. At its developer event last week, the company said a dot is an always-on agent. It can plug into more than four thousand apps, and it works in the background.
beats.image_prompt: A swarm of small glowing orbs connected by thin light threads to hundreds of floating app-like squares, deep blue night, cinematic

beats.text: So what is an agent? A chatbot answers a question and stops. An agent takes a goal, makes a plan, uses tools, and checks its own work.
beats.image_prompt: A friendly robotic hand moving chess pieces across a glowing board while a checklist of light beams ticks off one by one, no text, cinematic

beats.text: Here's how it works. First, you give it a job, like looking into a bug someone mentioned in Slack. Next, it uses its own cloud computer and browser to do the work. Finally, it brings you the result to approve.
beats.image_prompt: Three-stage visual metaphor: a hand passing a glowing key, a small computer working in clouds, a finished glowing package returned, cinematic vertical

beats.text: Quick pause... if this just made AI agents click for you, hit like, and share it with the friend who still thinks AI only chats.
beats.image_prompt: A group of silhouettes in a warm glowing room all looking at one bright screen, sparks of light rising, no faces visible, cinematic

beats.text: Now the safety part. Reports say users set rules for when a dot acts alone and when it must ask first. Sensitive things, like changing passwords, always stay with the human.
beats.image_prompt: A heavy glowing gate with a single human-shaped keyhole of light in front of a vast digital landscape, cinematic, no text

beats.text: Why does that matter? An agent can click, send and change things for you. Be careful about what you let it touch... because a mistake can happen at machine speed.
beats.image_prompt: A runaway glowing train of light rushing along tracks with a hand-shaped brake lever in the foreground, dramatic lighting, cinematic

beats.text: It also shows where the industry is heading. The same week, OpenAI said it shelved a more advanced model after researchers raised concerns.
beats.image_prompt: Two glowing runners on a night track, one far ahead, the other chasing with a lantern, dramatic cinematic

beats.text: Right now, dots are for Pro and Business Premium subscribers, with Enterprise access if admins turn it on.
beats.image_prompt: A row of identical glowing doors opening one by one in a long futuristic corridor, cinematic vertical

beats.text: So here are your takeaways. One, an agent is an AI that plans, uses tools and acts, not just chats. Two, always-on agents work while you are away, so set clear rules. Three, never hand over passwords or money decisions. Follow for a new AI lesson every day.
beats.image_prompt: Bright glowing three-step staircase of light rising toward a rising sun over a calm futuristic horizon, hopeful cinematic
